target_devices.description: List of target device names (e.g., sdb, sdc) to evaluate or write to. If empty, the tool operates on all detected devices based on other flags.

image_file_path.description: Path to the disk image file to be written. Used for -image_file and size comparison.

max_size_limit.description: Upper size limit for acceptable devices (e.g., '4G', '8000000000'). Corresponds to -max_size.

min_size_limit.description: Lower size limit for acceptable devices (e.g., '1G', '1000000'). Corresponds to -min_size.

look_for_iso.description: If true, requires ISO 9660 filesystem and overrides other filesystem prohibitions. Corresponds to -look_for_iso.

use_sudo.description: If true, uses sudo for filesystem detection and writing. Corresponds to -with_sudo.

trust_lsblk_udev.description: If true, suppresses errors if lsblk fails to detect filesystems without privileges but has udev. Corresponds to -trust_lsblk_udev.

plug_test.description: If true, initiates interactive plug test to find device. Corresponds to -plug_test.

do_write.description: If true, writes the image to the selected device. Corresponds to -DO_WRITE.

dummy_mode.description: If true, simulates writing without performing it. Corresponds to -dummy.

dummy_force.description: If true, forces dummy mode even against device advice. Corresponds to -dummy_force.

list_long.description: If true, prints detailed lsblk info. Corresponds to -list_long.

no_pacifier.description: If true, suppresses dd progress messages. Corresponds to -no_pacifier.
